BXAGI Showcase SC Subset

This is a modified static-weight subset of Noto Sans SC obtained from the official Google Fonts repository.
Original source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc
Original font: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/notosanssc/NotoSansSC%5Bwght%5D.ttf

Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name Source.
Licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1. See the accompanying unchanged OFL.txt.
The modified family is BXAGI Showcase SC Subset; the modified font does not use the Reserved Font Name as its family name.
Modifications: subset to the fixed showcase-v1 screen copy plus printable ASCII (see CHARACTERS.txt), instantiate a static weight of 600, and rename family, subfamily, unique and PostScript names.
Do not sell the font by itself. Keep the copyright notice and OFL.txt when redistributing this font resource.
No author endorsement is asserted. Videos, images and documents created using the font do not inherit the font license.

This is an input font resource for a BXAGI employee production task, not a video or other finished creative. The employee must create the actual output files. The font covers only CHARACTERS.txt; it is not a general-purpose Chinese font.
